Presented by UPMC and UPMC Health Plan, the Celebrity Golf Tournament is an annual event that benefits the Franco Harris Sports Museum. Each foursome will be paired with a sports celebrity for this scramble style tournament and will include team and individual prizes for longest putt, longest drive, and closest to the flag challenge.
sponsor Now

The Franco Harris Sports Museum celebrates the rich sports tradition of this region by telling a story that spans sporting events, eras, and skill levels. The Sports Museum takes visitors from the sandlot to the semi-pros, from the little leagues to the big leagues, and from the dreamers to the heroes of Western Pennsylvania sports.
For more sponsorship information, please contact Briana Hornung, special events manager, at bmhornung@heinzhistorycenter.org.
